title: LuckRead D1-05 W11 Analytics PostgreSQL Schema Slice

scope.migrationStrategy: One fresh PostgreSQL-native schema baseline representing the final admitted state of W11 D1 migrations 0001 through 0004. The SQLite migrations themselves are never executed on PostgreSQL.

excludedEntities.reason: Campaign is a W11 logical D1-03/T22 owner entity. No physical persistence source has been admitted; it is not inferred from analytics migration files.
GrowthOperation is a W11 logical D1-03/T22 owner entity. No physical persistence source has been admitted; it is not inferred from analytics migration files.

analytics_event_dedupe.purpose: Deduplicated source event ledger and durable PENDING/APPLIED/LATE projection state.
constraints: event_name is restricted to the admitted W01/W03 content telemetry and W05 social event allowlists
W01/W03 may emit content telemetry; only W05 may emit authoritative social/follow events
follow events require creator_id and omit content_id/content_type; other events require content_id/content_type
read_dwell, dwell and video_watch require duration_ms between 1 and 86400000; other events require duration_ms null
projection_status is PENDING, APPLIED or LATE

analytics_content_hourly.purpose: Hourly derived content and social-metric aggregates.

analytics_reconciliation_status.purpose: Bounded reconciliation-operation state with a PENDING/RUNNING/PASSED/FAILED lifecycle.

analytics_projection_rebuild_state.purpose: One singleton row for the latest hourly projection rebuild; no unbounded job history.
constraints: RUNNING has no completion/error; SUCCEEDED has completion and bucket counts; FAILED has completion and an allow-listed error code

postgresTypeMappings.TEXT: Keep source event timestamps, hour_start bucket keys, opaque IDs, details_json and status values as TEXT. Apply PostgreSQL COLLATE C to every UTC timestamp/bucket text column to preserve SQLite's default BINARY lexical comparison; do not introduce unapproved timestamp coercion or JSONB validation.
postgresTypeMappings.INTEGER: PostgreSQL INTEGER with the source range and non-negative checks preserved where present.
postgresTypeMappings.REAL: PostgreSQL DOUBLE PRECISION with the source 0..100 position constraint preserved.
postgresTypeMappings.ingested_at: TEXT with a UTC ISO-8601 millisecond default, preserving the D1 adapter's stored representation.

blockingRequirements.requirement: Retention policy for each event and derived aggregate class, including bounded late-event replay horizon
Deletion and privacy-request behavior for actor-linked and creator-linked analytics projections
Consent, lawful purpose and collection eligibility rules for anonymous and authenticated telemetry

admission.rule: A passing local PostgreSQL 18 schema rehearsal proves SQL compatibility only. It does not admit D1-05 source/runtime, authorize remote DDL, or waive the missing privacy/retention requirements. Do not invent retention durations.

privacy.creatorIdPurpose: Existing analytics aggregation dimension from the admitted D1 schema; remains subject to the missing consent/purpose/deletion policy.

nextGate: Admit explicit retention, deletion and consent/purpose policies; separately close W11 analytics operation security E2E. Only then may the D1-05 schema be admitted into a reviewed shared migration manifest. Remote Neon apply remains a later manually dispatched gate.
